description: PDF Bonus ablation: same architecture as bhojpuri/configs/model_config.json (the standard high-parameter Bhojpuri model -- 8 layers, 320 dim, 8 heads, 1280 FFN, 16K vocab, max_seq_len 256) with positional embeddings removed entirely (no absolute, no relative, no RoPE). Every other hyperparameter identical so the comparison isolates only the positional-embedding variable. Used by model/transformer_no_pos.py (BhojpuriTransformerNoPos), a new subclass of the standard BhojpuriTransformer -- does not modify model/transformer.py or configs/model_config.json.
